# Denzel Chingodza

CS student at Stellenbosch University, South Africa. Builds full-stack applications, developer tools, and AI systems.

## Projects

- **Sentinel**: serverless uptime monitoring and incident alerting built on AWS Lambda and DynamoDB. https://sentinel-kappa-wine.vercel.app
- **StackScope**: job market intelligence tool for South African developers. Tracks skills demand, salary ranges, and hiring trends. https://stack-scope-eight.vercel.app
- **ChunkDoc**: AI-powered document analyser for medical students. Upload a PDF and ask questions in plain English. Uses RAG with pgvector and GPT-4o-mini. https://doc-analyzer-as5k.vercel.app
- **AI Intelligence Layer**: FastAPI service that routes plain-English questions across all projects using GPT-4o-mini function calling. https://ai-intelligence-layer.vercel.app

## Stack

Python, Next.js, TypeScript, FastAPI, AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB, SES), PostgreSQL, pgvector, OpenAI API
